coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Incudini 2023: Propositions 1 and 2 are quoted with the optimal-regime assumption, so the error bound and Mercer result stay HIGH; the threshold count is stated in prose. Jager 2026: the formal Theorems 1 and 2 with Conditions 1 and 2, Corollaries B.2 and B.3 and the scope statements stay HIGH; the proof method, the odd-moment steps, the module isomorphism and the Supplementary propositions whose statements are cut or quoted by label are LOW, as is the estimator separation, quoted only as the text's summary of its bounds. Jeffery 2024: Theorems 3.13 and 4.1 and Lemma 3.24 are quoted with conditions and conclusions; Theorems 4.13 and 5.3, Theorem 4.15 and Lemma 4.10 are cut before their bounds, and the OR and AND bound loses its square root. Jerbi 2022: Theorems 3.1 and 4.1, Lemmas 3.1, 4.1, F.1 and C.1 are quoted with their conditions; Lemma B.2 loses the mark of the truncated value function. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
